description.original:
涛声 TaoSheng：用一部安卓手机全天收音 → 转写 → 认人 → AI 整理成待办与记忆。无需硬件、无需账号，数据只在你手机里。

1. 不用买任何硬件：手机麦克风就够；也支持领夹麦、蓝牙耳机等外接设备，插上自动切换，拔掉自动切回；还能接 Omi、声云录音卡等专用录音设备（试用，见下方第 31 条）。 2. 本地模型完全离线转写：可选 SenseVoice 本地识别（骁龙 NPU 加速），声音不出手机、不花一分钱；也可用豆包云端或自定义转写服务（OpenAI 兼容接口，或填写完整请求地址）。 3. ⏱ 自动转写 + 自动整理，时间自己定：转写间隔可设 15～720 分钟，转完自动整理成事件；每日回顾时间、技能运行时间都可调。 4. 声纹认人，分得清多个说话人：本机声纹认出“我”和熟人，多人会议自动分段；在原话上长按选“这是谁”，指定一次就能学会这个人的声音；每个人的声纹样本都能回放、删除。 5. 自动摘出待办：原话里答应的事、约好的时间自动变成待办；你说一句“发了”，它就知道这件事做完了。 6. 每天自动生成任务卡，技能随你定义：会议速记、收工打卡、每周回顾、情绪日记开箱即用；写一份 JSON + 提示词就能加自己的技能。 7.

description.original:
烽火台 — 创作者跨平台内容作战室。多平台热榜聚合、竞对监控、AI选题智囊团、一稿多平台改写、敏感词合规检测、数据看板。帮助创作者和内容团队用数据驱动内容决策，提升选题命中率与创作效率。零配置即可启动，支持接入任意 OpenAI 兼容大模型。

- 开箱就是成品，不用自己攒技能。通用 agent 装好之后是一张白纸：热榜从哪来、竞对怎么采、选题怎么打分、 小红书和公众号的格式差在哪，都得你自己写技能、调提示词、找数据源。烽火台把这些做成了现成的数据管线和界面： 多源热榜聚合去重、竞对作品库、六维选题评分、各平台可执行的格式规格、四级敏感词库、去 AI 味与事实漂移检测。 - 为国内内容生态做的。渠道是飞书、企业微信、钉钉、微信；平台是抖音、小红书、B 站、公众号、视频号 （采集、数据回填、发布表单预填按平台逐个适配）；模型接 DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi、GLM、MiniMax 这类国产端点； 合规检测按平台差异规则走，生成内容自动带显式 + 隐式 AIGC 标识。另两个项目的渠道与生态以海外为主。 - 对你的真实账号更保守。通用 agent 的默认是「权限内能做就做」；烽火台操作的是你赖以吃饭的账号， 所以发布、删除、支付、关注这类不可逆动作一律停在按钮前由你点，工具按职能白名单收窄，授权分三档， 登录态只留在你自己的浏览器里，不做指纹伪装、不调平台的非官方内部接口——宁可少一个功能，不拿你的号冒险。 -…

description.original:
Terminal session manager for AI coding agents. One TUI for Claude, Gemini, OpenCode, Codex, and more.

Agent Deck is mission control for your AI coding agents. Running Claude Code on ten projects, OpenCode on five more, another agent somewhere in the background? One terminal shows every session — running, waiting, or done — and one keystroke switches between them. Groups, search, forking, git worktrees, cost tracking, and a phone-controlled conductor keep a whole fleet manageable.
description.es: Director de sesión terminal para agentes de codificación IA. Un TUI para Claude, Gemini, OpenCode, Codex, y más. Agent Deck es control de misión para sus agentes de codificación IA. Running Claude Código sobre diez proyectos, OpenCode en cinco más, otro agente en algún lugar de fondo? Un terminal muestra cada sesión — corriendo, esperando o hecho— y un pulsador de teclas cambia entre ellos. Grupos, búsqueda, forking, git worktrees, seguimiento de costos, y un conductor controlado por teléfono mantienen a toda una flota manejable.

Terminal session manager for AI coding agents. One TUI for Claude, Gemini, OpenCode, Codex, and more.

original: Press m to open, Space to toggle, Tab to cycle scope (LOCAL/GLOBAL), type to jump

original: WeChat replies — answers @-mentions and her name in groups, keeps a conversation going while it is alive, and stays quiet when the topic ends
Memory — records facts from private chats, compresses older group history, and stays silent when an image or sticker cannot be read
Human-like delivery — splits a reply into short bubbles, avoids trailing punctuation, and rewrites repeated or parroted replies once
Extras — stickers, Moments reading and manual interaction, Markdown diary, voice replies, web search, hot lists, and basic group admin
One control panel — start, stop, configure, and diagnose everything from WhaleLauncher.exe

Memoria — registra hechos de chats privados, comprime la historia del grupo antiguo, y permanece en silencio cuando una imagen o pegatina no se puede leer
Entrega similar a la humana - divide una respuesta en burbujas cortas, evita la perforación y reescribe respuestas repetidas o analizadas una vez
Extras — pegatinas, lectura de Momentos e interacción manual, diario Markdown, respuestas de voz, búsqueda web, listas calientes y administración de grupo básico
Un panel de control — iniciar, detener, configurar y diagnosticar todo desde WhaleLauncher.exe

Vision Support: Upload and analyze images (.jpg, .png) (e.g., with llava) in Generate mode
Audio Support: Upload and analyze audio files (.wav, .mp3) (e.g., with gemma4) in Generate mode
Read Files: Import text files (.pdf, .txt, .json) to include their contents directly into the context

description.original:
Token efficient translation tool based on ChatGPT or any OpenAI compatible LLM chat completion API

This utility uses the OpenAI ChatGPT API to translate text, with a specific focus on line-based translation, especially for SRT subtitles. The translator optimizes token usage by removing SRT overhead and grouping text into batches, resulting in arbitrary length translations without excessive token consumption while ensuring a one-to-one match between line input and output.
description.es: Herramienta de traducción eficiente token basada en ChatGPT o cualquier OpenAI compatible LLM API Esta utilidad utiliza el OpenAI ChatGPT API para traducir texto, con un enfoque específico en la traducción en línea, especialmente para subtítulos SRT. El traductor optimiza el uso de token eliminando la sobrecarga de SRT y agrupando texto en lotes, lo que resulta en traducciones arbitrarias de longitud sin un consumo excesivo de token, garantizando al mismo tiempo una coincidencia entre la entrada de línea y la salida.
description.en:
Token efficient translation tool based on ChatGPT or any OpenAI compatible LLM chat completion API

Prompt engineering is a relatively new discipline for developing and optimizing prompts to efficiently use language models (LMs) for a wide variety of applications and research topics. Researchers use prompt engineering to improve the capacity of LLMs on a wide range of common and complex tasks such as question answering and arithmetic reasoning.

description.original:
A neurosymbolic perspective on LLMs

SymbolicAI is a neuro-symbolic framework, combining classical Python programming with the differentiable, programmable nature of LLMs in a way that actually feels natural in Python. It's built to not stand in the way of your ambitions. It's easily extensible and customizable to your needs by virtue of its modular design. It's quite easy to write your own engine, host locally an engine of your choice, or interface with tools like web search or image generation.
description.es: Una perspectiva neurosimbólico en LLMs SymbolicAI es un marco neuro-simbólico, combinando la programación clásica Python con la naturaleza diferenciable y programable de LLMs de una manera que realmente se siente natural en Python. Está construido para no estar en el camino de sus ambiciones. Es fácilmente extensible y personalizable a sus necesidades en virtud de su diseño modular. Es bastante fácil escribir su propio motor, albergar localmente un motor de su elección, o interfaz con herramientas como búsqueda web o generación de imagen.
description.en:
A neurosymbolic perspective on LLMs

SymbolicAI is a neuro-symbolic framework, combining classical Python programming with the differentiable, programmable nature of LLMs in a way that actually feels natural in Python. It's built to not stand in the way of your ambitions. It's easily extensible and customizable to your needs by virtue of its modular design. description.original:
2026全新ChatGPT Plus充值订阅教程(国内ChatGPT代充购买必看)

为什么你的信用卡会 100% 被秒拒？ 很多新手不信邪，非要拿自己的双币卡或者去网上随便买个虚拟卡去试，结果不仅付款失败，连账号都被封了。这是因为 OpenAI 背后使用的是全球最严苛的 Stripe 支付网关。 Stripe 采用的是极其变态的“三方交叉风控”：它会在扣费瞬间，同时核对你的物理 IP 纯净度、你注册时的账号归属地轨迹、以及你信用卡的账单地址（Billing Address）。国内绝大部分的梯子节点早就被 Stripe 拉黑了。只要这三个信息对不上号，或者卡片号段被标记，Stripe 会直接触发风控拦截，甚至对你的 OpenAI 账号进行“连坐封禁”。这也是为什么强烈建议大家不要自己瞎折腾支付的原因。

免 ROOT 免 Termux，一个 APK 在安卓手机上跑 DeepSeek Harness。引擎内嵌 App 进程 · 读屏操作 App · 改系统设置 · 定时/条件自动化 · 可选 Shizuku

- 手机上的 App 都能操作：用微信发消息、总结群聊，抓取小红书上的内容，在 BOSS 直聘上直接投递、打招呼，去淘宝帮你下单，等等。 - 它操作，你照常用手机：授权后 Agent 能读屏、点按、输入，过程中你可以随时暂停、停止或插话。Android 14 及以上支持“不打扰模式”：配好 Shizuku 或自连 ADB 后，Agent 在虚拟屏幕上操作，不占用你的屏幕。 - 在任何 App 里随时呼起：用悬浮球直接对话、派活，也可以把当前这一屏发给它，问“这条怎么回”“帮我记下来”。 - 手机里自带 Linux 环境：Agent 可以跑 Python、处理你发来的文件、运行它自己写的脚本。 - 出门也能用电脑上的 Agent：通过 SSH 或 DSH Remote 连接电脑或服务器上的 DSH。只用远程模式的话，手机不用安装本地运行环境。

Desktop app for Claude Code: a roster of bots, each with its own model, working directory and persistent conversation

Kiroshi is a desktop app where you keep a team of agents. Each Agent has a name, a face, a job, a folder to work in and a memory of its own. original: Plain-language mission planning: asks local Ollama for a reviewable workflow, with an offline fallback
No dedicated GPU required: Ollama can run small quantized models on CPU. Inference may be slower and needs enough RAM
Registered tool adapters: the app builds argument arrays itself. Model output is never executed as a command
Target and scope checks: rejects shell syntax, malformed hostnames, URLs in the target field, and overly broad CIDR scans
Execution boundaries: no arbitrary shell, no implicit root privileges, explicit authorization acknowledgement, per-run timeout, output cap
Useful results: captured stdout/stderr, recent activity stored locally in the app webview, and plain-text report export
es: Planificación de la misión de lenguaje simple: pide a Ollama local un flujo de trabajo repasable, con un retroceso sin conexión
No se requiere GPU específico: Ollama puede ejecutar pequeños modelos cuantificados en CPU. La inferencia puede ser más lenta y necesita suficiente RAM
Adaptadores de herramientas registrados: la aplicación construye arrays de argumentos. La salida del modelo nunca se ejecuta como un comando
Controles de objetivos y alcance: rechaza sintaxis de cáscaras, nombres de host malformados, URLs en el campo de destino, y escaneos CIDR demasiado amplios
Límites de ejecución: sin conchas arbitrarias, sin privilegios de raíz implícitos, reconocimiento explícito de autorización, tiempo de salida por ejecución, tapa de salida
Resultados útiles: stdout/stderr capturado, actividad reciente almacenada localmente en la vista web de la aplicación, y exportación de un informe de texto claro

流声字幕：基于 ASR 与 LLM 生成、翻译流媒体视频字幕的 Chrome 扩展。 / Chrome extension for ASR + LLM subtitles on streaming videos.

- 将长时间识别与翻译迁移到持久化的 offscreen 执行链路，MV3 后台进程重启后可根据本机任务状态继续同一任务。 - 停止任务会中断正在进行的识别与翻译请求，并跟踪 FunASR 远端取消；付费请求保存恢复检查点，消息确认丢失时不会盲目重复提交。 - 切换浏览器标签页后，侧边栏会自动恢复该页面的任务；翻译请求默认超时由 90 秒提高到 120 秒。 - 提升 HLS、DASH、MSE 与直连媒体的执行稳定性：按来源保留必要请求头、串行执行 Web FFmpeg 抽取，并安全恢复页面媒体监听钩子。 - 本地文件任务可在 Chrome 权限仍有效时复用只读文件句柄进行重试或重新抽取；临时任务、音频和付费响应增加本机自动清理策略。 - 普通 ASR 任务会在创建时固定识别服务支持的 VAD 与质量参数，并在后台恢复、offscreen 执行和重新 ASR 时保持一致，避免静音段因请求参数丢失产生额外幻觉字幕。 - 翻译任务会保留页面标题、简介、页面语言和频道信息，使持久化执行后的翻译仍能使用完整上下文。

original: Chat in the side panel: say what you need in plain words. The agent reads pages, clicks, types and moves between tabs to get it done

An AI-powered desktop tool that scans a codebase, generates documentation for undocumented functions, classes, and structs using a local LLM, and can reformat the code to match preferred styles — all running entirely on your own machine. Your source code is never uploaded anywhere.

Su código fuente nunca se carga en ningún lugar.

description.original:
Make AI browser agents read-only: a Chrome extension that refuses writes (send, post, edit, delete) before they leave the browser.

The read-only mode for AI agents in the browser. Hand any agent that drives your browser your real inbox, calendar and work tools: reads pass, and every send, post, like, edit, delete or settings change is refused before it leaves the browser.
description.es: Haga que los agentes del navegador IA solo lean: una extensión Chrome que se niega a escribir (enviar, publicar, editar, borrar) antes de que abandonen el navegador. El modo sólo lectura para los agentes de IA en el navegador. Maneje cualquier agente que conduzca su navegador su bandeja de entrada real, calendario y herramientas de trabajo: lee pase, y cada envío, correo, como, edición, borrado o configuración cambio se rechaza antes de que abandone el navegador.

description.original:
The open LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium: NKI megakernels, 1M-token context, OpenAI-compatible API. By RunAnywhere.

TrnRT is an open inference engine for large language models on AWS Trainium. It serves an OpenAI-compatible API from one trn2.48xlarge, runs decode as NKI megakernels (about one kernel per layer half), and keeps a prefix cache across device and host memory. GLM-5.3-Flash is the first supported model; more open models are on the way.

TrnRT es un motor de inferencia abierto para modelos de lenguaje grande en AWS Trainium. Sirve un OpenAI -compatible API de un trn2.48xlarge, corre decodificado como megakernels NKI (sobre un núcleo por capa media), y mantiene un caché prefijo a través del dispositivo y la memoria host. GLM- 5.3 -Flash es el primer modelo compatible; están en camino modelos más abiertos.

original: Full Power Of ComfyUI: The server supports the full ComfyUI /prompt API, and can be used to execute any ComfyUI workflow
Stateless API: The server is stateless, and can be scaled horizontally to handle more requests
Swagger Docs: The server hosts swagger docs at /docs, which can be used to interact with the API
Synchronous" Support: The server will return base64-encoded images directly in the response, if no async behavior is requested
Async Support via Webhooks: The server can send completed outputs to a webhook URL, allowing for asynchronous processing
Return Images In PNG (default), JPEG, or WebP: The server can return images in PNG, JPEG, or WebP format, via a parameter in the API request

AI 团队群聊 · 桌面版 —— 四个不同模型的 AI 在同一窗口讨论、分工、联网搜索、写文件，中文界面

- 角色完全自定义 —— 想加几个 AI 就加几个,随时增删改;每个角色单独配名称、颜色、模型来源、凭据、人设和可用工具,发言顺序就是列表顺序。内置经理/策划/工程师/评审/研究员/唱反调/执笔等预设,点一下就能加 - 可以一直追问 —— 讨论完直接接着问"把预算再压低 20%",它们记得之前的上下文;想重新开始点「新会话」 - 逐字流式显示 —— 不用盯着空屏等一整段生成完 - 各家模型随便接 —— 智谱 GLM(有免费额度)、本地 Ollama、任何 OpenAI 兼容接口(DeepSeek、Kimi 之类) - API Key 加密保存 —— 用 Windows 自带的 DPAPI 按当前用户加密,配置文件里看不到明文 - AI 会用几个小工具 —— 联网搜索、读写文件、查 GitHub、执行只读命令,每个角色能用的工具可以单独勾 - 界面是 ChatGPT 那种布局 —— 左侧会话栏、正文居中、底部圆角输入框;整屏几乎不用彩色,颜色只留给角色标记 - 配置面板随时可开 —— 没有首次启动教程,想改随时点「配置」;缺什么会直接在对话流里提示 - 自动存档 ——…

description.original:
RAG over GitHub issues, with a hand-reviewed eval set and an audit of the judge itself. Reports the interval, not just the best number.

1. 检索确实有用，增益 2.3×–3.2×（换更严的判分器得到 2.3×，人工盲评给到 5.2×，所以机器测的是下界）。不是 4 倍。 2. 四种检索配置之间无法区分——换判分器排序就翻转，最大差距 0.03，落在判分器自身噪声（0.005–0.026）附近。能站住的只有「闭卷永远最差」和「增益区间」。 3. 判分器被审计了四个轴：换判分模型、同模型跑两遍、换 rubric 版本、以及 30 条人工盲评（一致率 70.0%，二次加权 κ=0.816）。人工还发现判分器低估了增益：对泛泛建议过宽 +0.100，对真实答案过严 −0.133。

description.original:
Video generation with a synchronized soundtrack

This Space generates video and its soundtrack using the public MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 checkpoint. The transformer runs in bfloat16 without quantization; the video and audio VAEs stay in float32. The latter is intentional: the released autoencoders declare _keep_in_fp32_modules, and forcing the audio VAE to bf16 affected volume in the original deployment's tests.
description.es: Generación de vídeo con una banda sonora sincronizada Este espacio genera vídeo y su banda sonora usando el control público MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3. El transformador funciona en bfloat16 sin cuantificación; el vídeo y el audio VAEs permanecen en flota32. Este último es intencional: los autoencoders liberados declaran keep in fp32 modules, y obligan al audio VAE a bf16 volumen afectado en las pruebas del despliegue original.
description.en:
Video generation with a synchronized soundtrack

This Space generates video and its soundtrack using the public MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 checkpoint. The transformer runs in bfloat16 without quantization; the video and audio VAEs stay in float32. The latter is intentional: the released autoencoders declare _keep_in_fp32_modules, and forcing the audio VAE to bf16 affected volume in the original deployment's tests.

description.original:
FastVideo 8-step video+audio from image/video/audio refs

FastVideo's 8-step FastH3-Omni student of MiniMax-H3 on ZeroGPU: ordered image, video and audio references plus a prompt become a short clip with a matching soundtrack. Runs the FP8 W8A8 export (FastVideo/FastH3-Omni-FP8) with FastVideo's Triton tile-64 block-sparse attention, and restores its compiled kernels from multimodalart/fasth3-omni-kernel-cache at startup so the first call doesn't JIT-compile.
description.es: FastVideo 8-step video+audio de imagen/video/audio refs El estudiante de 8 pasos de FastVideo FastH3-Omni de MiniMax-H3 en ZeroGPU: las referencias de imagen ordenada, vídeo y audio más un impulso se convierten en un corto clip con una banda sonora coincidente. Ejecuta la exportación FP8 W8A8 (FastVideo/ FastH3-Omni -FP8) con la atención Triton Tile-64 block-sparse de FastVideo, y restaura sus núcleos compilados desde multimodalart/fasth3-omni-kernel-cache al inicio, por lo que la primera llamada no es compatible con JIT.
description.en:
FastVideo 8-step video+audio from image/video/audio refs

FastVideo's 8-step FastH3-Omni student of MiniMax-H3 on ZeroGPU: ordered image, video and audio references plus a prompt become a short clip with a matching soundtrack. Runs the FP8 W8A8 export (FastVideo/FastH3-Omni-FP8) with FastVideo's Triton tile-64 block-sparse attention, and restores its compiled kernels from multimodalart/fasth3-omni-kernel-cache at startup so the first call doesn't JIT-compile.

Text-to-image and image editing, based on MiniMax-H3

- / — Studio (gr.Server API + custom UI, Pruna design, dark and light themes): Generate and Edit modes with prompt upsampling, aspect-ratio and resolution controls (4 / 8 / 16 MP text-to-image, 4 / 8 MP edits at the source's aspect ratio), up to 8 reference images, seed control, all of the original examples, before/after split view, run history with one-click restore, and the upsampled prompt after each run. Both modes call the same _render as the classic UI did.

Ambos modos llaman el mismo render que el clásico UI.
description.en:
